theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  change NormalizedOldExpr post → ∀ x, x ∈ extractOldExprVars post → x ∈ Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars post
  intro Hnorm x
  induction Hnorm <;>
    simp only [extractOldExprVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append, List.not_mem_nil] at * <;>
    try grind only
  case app H1 H2 Hn ih1 ih2 =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact fun h => Or.inr h
    · next Hfalse =>
      have h := Hn IsOldPred.oldPred
      cases h
      exfalso
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    · simpa only [List.mem_append] using Or.imp ih1 ih2
